"""LLM classification of inconclusive Workday authentication walls."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from cloud.services.agent_runner._navigation_dependencies import (
    AuthenticationStrategyRuntime,
    build_navigation_auth_adapter,
)
from cloud.services.agent_runner._navigation_dependencies import wall_classifier
from cloud.services.agent_runner._navigation_dependencies.wall_classifier import (
    WALL_CLASSIFIER_ENABLED_ENV,
    WALL_CLASSIFIER_MAX_CHARS_ENV,
    LlmWallClassifier,
)
from src.browser_runtime.page_ops.authentication import (
    AUTH_RESULT_AUTHENTICATED,
    AuthMutationKind,
    AuthMutationRequest,
    AuthResult,
)
from src.llm.types import TransientLLMError
from tests.graph._navigation_authentication_forms import FORM_CREDENTIALS, FormPage

pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit

_LOGIN_REQUEST = AuthMutationRequest(
    action_id="auth:page-2:login_submit",
    kind=AuthMutationKind.LOGIN_SUBMIT,
    job_url="https://careers.example.test/jobs/42",
    pre_action_signature="navigation-step.v1:auth-page-2",
)
_LOGIN_WALL_URL = "https://acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/jobs/login"

#: Real Workday candidate sign-in rejection wording that the deterministic
#: INVALID_LOGIN_SIGNALS list does not contain.
_WORKDAY_REJECTION_BODY = (
    "Sign In\nWe couldn't sign you in. Please double check your username and "
    "password.\nEmail Address\nPassword"
)


class _RecordingClassifier:
    """Stub wall classifier recording invocations, returning one canned label."""

    def __init__(self, label: AuthResult) -> None:
        self._label = label
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    async def classify(self, url: str, page_text: str) -> AuthResult:
        self.calls.append((url, page_text))
        return self._label


def _login_wall_page(body: str) -> FormPage:
    page = FormPage.login_wall(body)
    page.defer_submit_transition = True
    return page


def _reveal_formless_wall(page: FormPage):
    async def clear_controls(_delay: float) -> None:
        page.present = set()

    return clear_controls


async def test_login_submit_refines_unrecognized_rejection_via_wall_classifier(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    page = _login_wall_page(_WORKDAY_REJECTION_BODY)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "src.cli.auth._orchestrate.login.anyio.sleep",
        _reveal_formless_wall(page),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "cloud.services.agent_runner._navigation_dependencies.get_active_page",
        lambda: page,
    )
    classifier = _RecordingClassifier("invalid_credentials")
    adapter = build_navigation_auth_adapter(
        strategies=AuthenticationStrategyRuntime(
            lambda: FORM_CREDENTIALS, None, wall_classifier=classifier
        )
    )

    outcome = await adapter.mutate(_LOGIN_REQUEST)

    assert outcome == "invalid_credentials", (
        "real-world rejection wording must reach the graph as invalid_credentials"
    )
    assert len(classifier.calls) == 1, (
        "the classifier must run exactly once on the finalized wall observation"
    )


async def test_definitive_signal_walls_skip_the_wall_classifier(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    page = _login_wall_page("Invalid user name or password")
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "src.cli.auth._orchestrate.login.anyio.sleep",
        _reveal_formless_wall(page),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "cloud.services.agent_runner._navigation_dependencies.get_active_page",
        lambda: page,
    )
    classifier = _RecordingClassifier("signup_needed")
    adapter = build_navigation_auth_adapter(
        strategies=AuthenticationStrategyRuntime(
            lambda: FORM_CREDENTIALS, None, wall_classifier=classifier
        )
    )

    outcome = await adapter.mutate(_LOGIN_REQUEST)

    assert outcome == "invalid_credentials", (
        "signal-classified walls must keep their deterministic outcome"
    )
    assert classifier.calls == [], (
        "the LLM classifier must not run when deterministic signals are decisive"
    )


async def test_wall_classifier_maps_llm_label_to_typed_result(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    captured: dict[str, str] = {}

    async def fake_invoke(prompt: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        captured["prompt"] = prompt
        return {"label": "account_not_found"}

    monkeypatch.setattr(wall_classifier, "invoke_json_llm", fake_invoke)

    outcome = await LlmWallClassifier().classify(_LOGIN_WALL_URL, "No account found")

    assert outcome == "account_not_found", (
        "the classifier must map LLM labels into the closed AuthResult vocabulary"
    )
    assert _LOGIN_WALL_URL in captured["prompt"], "the prompt must ground on the URL"
    for label in ("invalid_credentials", "signup_needed", "authenticated"):
        assert f'"{label}"' in captured["prompt"], (
            "the prompt must declare the full allowed label vocabulary"
        )


async def test_wall_classifier_abstains_on_unknown_label(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    async def fake_invoke(prompt: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {"label": "server_on_fire"}

    monkeypatch.setattr(wall_classifier, "invoke_json_llm", fake_invoke)

    outcome = await LlmWallClassifier().classify(_LOGIN_WALL_URL, "Sign In")

    assert outcome == "login_required", (
        "out-of-vocabulary labels must fall back to the deterministic pass-through"
    )


async def test_wall_classifier_abstains_on_unparseable_response(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    async def fake_invoke(prompt: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {}

    monkeypatch.setattr(wall_classifier, "invoke_json_llm", fake_invoke)

    outcome = await LlmWallClassifier().classify(_LOGIN_WALL_URL, "Sign In")

    assert outcome == "login_required", (
        "unparseable LLM responses must fall back to the deterministic pass-through"
    )


async def test_wall_classifier_abstains_on_transient_llm_error(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    async def failing_invoke(prompt: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        raise TransientLLMError("provider unavailable")

    monkeypatch.setattr(wall_classifier, "invoke_json_llm", failing_invoke)

    outcome = await LlmWallClassifier().classify(_LOGIN_WALL_URL, "Sign In")

    assert outcome == "login_required", (
        "transient LLM failures must never break the authentication run"
    )


async def test_wall_classifier_respects_enable_gate(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(WALL_CLASSIFIER_ENABLED_ENV, "0")

    async def forbidden_invoke(prompt: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        raise AssertionError("a disabled classifier must not call the LLM")

    monkeypatch.setattr(wall_classifier, "invoke_json_llm", forbidden_invoke)

    outcome = await LlmWallClassifier().classify(_LOGIN_WALL_URL, "Sign In")

    assert outcome == "login_required", "a disabled classifier must pass through"


async def test_wall_classifier_bounds_page_text_prompt(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    captured: dict[str, str] = {}

    async def fake_invoke(prompt: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        captured["prompt"] = prompt
        return {"label": "login_required"}

    monkeypatch.setattr(wall_classifier, "invoke_json_llm", fake_invoke)
    monkeypatch.setenv(WALL_CLASSIFIER_MAX_CHARS_ENV, "1000")

    outcome = await LlmWallClassifier().classify(_LOGIN_WALL_URL, "7" * 9000)

    assert outcome == "login_required"
    assert captured["prompt"].count("7") == 1000, (
        "page text must be truncated to the configured prompt budget"
    )


def test_authenticated_pass_through_remains_in_vocabulary() -> None:
    assert AUTH_RESULT_AUTHENTICATED == "authenticated"
